# ArtSiren: all artist profiles

> 246 artists with at least 2 established news sources, with their documented stance on the cultural boycott of Israel. Generated 2026-11-28. Each line links to the artist's profile page, which lists every source URL. Stances: Cultural Boycott, Stance Unclear, Welcomes All (see https://artsiren.co/llms.txt).

- [A Silver Mt. Zion](https://artsiren.co/artist/a-silver-mt-zion/): Cultural Boycott. Montréal post-rock collective led by Efrim Menuck who signed open letters supporting a cultural boycott of Israel; closely associated with Godspeed You! Black Emperor, whose members have been vocal advocates for Palestinian rights and the BDS movement (Sources: Exclaim!, Billboard Canada)
- [Adam McKay](https://artsiren.co/artist/adam-mckay/): Cultural Boycott. Signed the Film Workers for Palestine pledge (September 2025), committing to boycott Israeli film institutions 'implicated in genocide and apartheid against the Palestinian people'; director of The Big Short, Don't Look Up and Vice. (Sources: Rolling Stone, NPR, Deadline)
- [Aimee Lou Wood](https://artsiren.co/artist/aimee-lou-wood/): Cultural Boycott. Signed the Film Workers for Palestine pledge (September 2025) as a notable initial signatory, refusing to work with Israeli film institutions complicit in genocide; English actress known for Sex Education and The White Lotus. (Sources: TheWrap, Screen Daily)
- [Alexei Sayle](https://artsiren.co/artist/alexei-sayle/): Cultural Boycott. British comedian and actor who has been a vocal public supporter of Palestinian rights and BDS; made numerous statements calling for cultural boycott of Israel and written about it in the press (Sources: Al Jazeera, The JC)
- [Alice Walker](https://artsiren.co/artist/alice-walker/): Cultural Boycott. Author of 'The Color Purple' who refused to allow an Israeli publisher to publish her book; explicitly supports BDS; has written about and spoken at pro-Palestinian events calling for boycott of Israel (Sources: NBC News, JTA)
- [Alicia Keys](https://artsiren.co/artist/alicia-keys/): Welcomes All. Performed in Tel Aviv in 2013 despite BDS calls and an open letter from Alice Walker urging her to cancel. She chose to go ahead with the concert, stating she believed in the power of music to bring people together. (Sources: JTA, Times of Israel)
- [Amy Schumer](https://artsiren.co/artist/amy-schumer/): Welcomes All. Signed the Creative Community for Peace open letter supporting Israel's inclusion in Eurovision 2026 and opposing cultural boycotts. (Sources: Ynet, Jerusalem Post)
- [Amyl and the Sniffers](https://artsiren.co/artist/amyl-and-the-sniffers/): Cultural Boycott. Signed No Music for Genocide pledge, geo-blocked music from Israel and requested removal from Spotify Israel; Australian punk band from Melbourne known for ferocious live shows and singer Amy Taylor's confrontational stage presence (Sources: Haaretz, NPR, Billboard, Rolling Stone, NME, The National)
- [Ana Tijoux](https://artsiren.co/artist/ana-tijoux/): Cultural Boycott. Signed No Music for Genocide pledge, geo-blocked music from Israel and requested removal from Spotify Israel; French-Chilean hip-hop artist known for her politically charged music and solidarity with Indigenous and Palestinian struggles (Sources: Haaretz, NPR, Billboard, Rolling Stone, NME, The National)
- [Andrea Bocelli](https://artsiren.co/artist/andrea-bocelli/): Welcomes All. Performed at a Tel Aviv stadium in 2022 despite calls to boycott, with Benjamin Netanyahu, then a former prime minister, in the audience, and sang in Jerusalem's Old City in 2011. In October 2026 the BDS movement's Jordan chapter called for a boycott of his November 27 concert at Petra over his support for Israel, and Indonesia's top Muslim council opposed his concerts in Indonesia on the same grounds. (Sources: Times of Israel, Ynet)
- [Andrew Garfield](https://artsiren.co/artist/andrew-garfield/): Cultural Boycott. Signed Film Workers for Palestine pledge (September 2025) to boycott Israeli film institutions implicated in genocide and apartheid (Sources: The Wrap, NBC News)
- [Annie Ernaux](https://artsiren.co/artist/annie-ernaux/): Cultural Boycott. 2022 Nobel Prize in Literature laureate who publicly signed BDS-aligned letters after receiving her Nobel Prize; made explicit statements calling Israeli actions a form of apartheid and genocide (Sources: Al Jazeera, Jerusalem Post, Euronews)
- [Anthony Edwards](https://artsiren.co/artist/anthony-edwards/): Welcomes All. Signed the Creative Community for Peace open letter supporting Israel's inclusion in Eurovision 2026 and was among over 1,200 entertainment figures who signed a letter opposing boycotts of Israeli film institutions. (Sources: Ynet, Times of Israel)
- [Arca](https://artsiren.co/artist/arca/): Cultural Boycott. Signed No Music for Genocide pledge, geo-blocked music from Israel and requested removal from Spotify Israel; Venezuelan-born experimental electronic producer known for avant-garde work and collaborations with Bjork, Kanye West, and FKA Twigs (Sources: Haaretz, NPR, Billboard, Rolling Stone, NME, The National)
- [Arundhati Roy](https://artsiren.co/artist/arundhati-roy/): Cultural Boycott. Booker Prize-winning Indian novelist and activist who is one of the world's most prominent literary advocates for BDS; has signed open letters, spoken at boycott events, and written extensively calling for cultural and economic sanctions against Israel. Signed the October 2024 'Refusing Complicity' letter, in which thousands of writers pledged to boycott Israeli cultural institutions. (Sources: Al Jazeera, Ynet)
- [Asif Kapadia](https://artsiren.co/artist/asif-kapadia/): Cultural Boycott. BAFTA and Oscar-winning British documentary director best known for 'Amy' and 'Senna' who signed the 2023 Artists' Pledge for Palestine and the Film Workers for Palestine pledge, calling on UK arts to oppose Israeli state cultural funding (Sources: Screen Daily, NBC News)
- [AURORA](https://artsiren.co/artist/aurora/): Cultural Boycott. Signed No Music for Genocide pledge, geo-blocked music from Israel and requested removal from Spotify Israel; Norwegian folk-pop artist known for ethereal music and as the voice behind the viral hit 'Runaway'; one of the most-streamed Scandinavian artists to join the boycott (Sources: Haaretz, NPR, Billboard, Rolling Stone, NME, The National)
- [Ava DuVernay](https://artsiren.co/artist/ava-duvernay/): Cultural Boycott. Signed the Film Workers for Palestine pledge (September 2025), refusing to work with Israeli film institutions 'complicit in genocide and apartheid'; director of Selma, 13th, and When They See Us. (Sources: NPR, Deadline)
- [Ayo Edebiri](https://artsiren.co/artist/ayo-edebiri/): Cultural Boycott. Among the initial signatories of Film Workers for Palestine pledge (September 8, 2025) to boycott Israeli film institutions implicated in genocide and apartheid (Sources: Hollywood Reporter, JTA)
- [BADBADNOTGOOD](https://artsiren.co/artist/badbadnotgood/): Cultural Boycott. Signed No Music for Genocide pledge, geo-blocked music from Israel and requested removal from Spotify Israel; Canadian jazz-influenced instrumental trio known for collaborations with Ghostface Killah and acclaimed albums combining jazz and hip-hop (Sources: Haaretz, NPR, Billboard, Rolling Stone, NME, The National)
- [Beoga](https://artsiren.co/artist/beoga/): Cultural Boycott. Irish folk band that played as Ed Sheeran's backing band; quit the rest of his US Loop Tour in September 2026 after Macklemore was removed over his 'Free Palestine' remarks, saying 'we are Irish people who understand colonialism' and describing themselves as 'founding members of the Irish Artists for Palestine movement' and 'committed activists for justice'. The band later said 'Free Palestine' on RTÉ's The Late Late Show. (Sources: Irish Times, RTÉ)
- [Billie Eilish](https://artsiren.co/artist/billie-eilish/): Cultural Boycott. Wore 'Artists for Ceasefire' pin at the Oscars (March 2024); called Israel's plan to forcibly relocate Palestinians from Rafah 'horrifying' (July 2025); appeared in 'Together for Palestine' benefit video alongside Finneas, Cillian Murphy, and Joaquin Phoenix — 'Call for a ceasefire, stop the killing' (September 2025) (Sources: Variety, Billboard, NME)
- [Björk](https://artsiren.co/artist/bjork/): Cultural Boycott. Signed No Music for Genocide pledge in 2025 and geo-blocked her entire catalogue from Israeli streaming services; one of the most high-profile artists to join the streaming boycott (Sources: Times of Israel, Haaretz, NPR, Billboard, Rolling Stone, NME)
- [Blonde Redhead](https://artsiren.co/artist/blonde-redhead/): Cultural Boycott. Signed No Music for Genocide pledge, geo-blocked music from Israel and requested removal from Spotify Israel; Italian-American art rock trio known for ethereal, art-damaged sound and critically acclaimed albums including '23' (Sources: Haaretz, NPR, Billboard, Rolling Stone, NME, The National)
- [Blood Orange](https://artsiren.co/artist/blood-orange/): Cultural Boycott. Signed No Music for Genocide pledge, geo-blocked music from Israel and requested removal from Spotify Israel; British-American artist Dev Hynes known for lush R&B production and collaborations with Solange, FKA Twigs, and many others (Sources: Haaretz, NPR, Billboard, Rolling Stone, NME, The National)
- [Bob Vylan](https://artsiren.co/artist/bob-vylan/): Cultural Boycott. Chanted 'Death to the IDF' at Glastonbury 2025 in a performance broadcast live on the BBC; the US State Department subsequently revoked their visas; also pressured concert venues to drop pro-Israel sponsor Barclays. (Sources: NBC News – Visa Ban, NBC News – Bob Vylan Response, NME, CNN)
- [Bon Jovi](https://artsiren.co/artist/bon-jovi/): Welcomes All. Performed in Israel despite boycott pressure, headlining concerts in Tel Aviv. Jon Bon Jovi has spoken warmly about Israeli audiences and declined to cancel shows. (Sources: Times of Israel, JTA, Rolling Stone)
- [Boots Riley](https://artsiren.co/artist/boots-riley/): Cultural Boycott. The Coup frontman and director of 'Sorry to Bother You' who signed the USACBI boycott declaration calling for boycott and divestment from Israel; has publicly linked Palestinian liberation to working-class and anti-imperialist politics. Also signed the Film Workers for Palestine pledge (September 2025), refusing to work with Israeli film institutions it calls complicit in genocide. (Sources: Billboard, NBC News)
- [Bowen Yang](https://artsiren.co/artist/bowen-yang/): Cultural Boycott. Signed the Film Workers for Palestine pledge (September 2025), pledging not to work with Israeli film institutions complicit in genocide; SNL cast member and comedian best known for his breakout role on Saturday Night Live. (Sources: Variety, NBC News)
- [Boy George](https://artsiren.co/artist/boy-george/): Welcomes All. Signed the 2024 Creative Community for Peace open letter supporting Israel's inclusion in Eurovision and publicly vowed he 'won't turn his back on his Jewish friends' amid calls to boycott Eurovision; Culture Club frontman. In November 2026 he defied the cultural boycott to play two shows at Tel Aviv's Menora Mivtachim Arena, his first in Israel since 2017; the second was dedicated to Nova festival survivors. During the visit he met President Isaac Herzog and visited the Nova memorial site. (Sources: NME, Billboard, Times of Israel, Jerusalem Post)
- [Brian Eno](https://artsiren.co/artist/brian-eno/): Cultural Boycott. Organised the 'Together for Palestine' benefit concert at Wembley Arena; co-authored an open letter calling Israel's military campaign 'a well-planned genocide'; signed No Music for Genocide pledge; has written extensively calling for sanctions against Israel (Sources: Haaretz, NPR, Billboard, Rolling Stone, NME)
- [Caribou](https://artsiren.co/artist/caribou/): Cultural Boycott. Signed No Music for Genocide pledge, geo-blocked music from Israel and requested removal from Spotify Israel; Canadian musician and producer Dan Snaith known for psychedelic electronic music; also signed the #DJsForPalestine boycott statement in 2018 (Sources: Haaretz, NPR, Billboard, Rolling Stone, NME, The National)
- [Cassandra Wilson](https://artsiren.co/artist/cassandra-wilson/): Cultural Boycott. American jazz vocalist and Grammy Award winner who joined the artistic boycott of Israel in 2012, explicitly declining an invitation to perform at Israeli-sponsored events and expressing public support for Palestinian rights (Sources: Haaretz, Ynetnews)
- [Cat Power](https://artsiren.co/artist/cat-power/): Cultural Boycott. American indie singer-songwriter Chan Marshall who signed the 2021 Musicians for Palestine open letter alongside 600+ artists calling for a cultural boycott of Israel; long associated with activist and politically engaged music communities. In February 2012 she cancelled a Tel Aviv concert, citing the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. (Sources: Consequence, JTA, Times of Israel)
- [Charlotte Church](https://artsiren.co/artist/charlotte-church/): Cultural Boycott. Repeatedly used the chant 'From the River to the Sea, Palestine will be free' at her shows and publicly defended doing so; stated her family received threats over her support for Gaza; among the most outspoken British artists condemning Israeli actions (Sources: NME, NME (threats), Jerusalem Post)
- [Chris Pine](https://artsiren.co/artist/chris-pine/): Welcomes All. Signed the Creative Community for Peace statement rejecting the cultural boycott of Israel. (Sources: The Hollywood Reporter, Variety)
- [Clairo](https://artsiren.co/artist/clairo/): Cultural Boycott. Signed No Music for Genocide pledge, geo-blocked music from Israel and requested removal from Spotify Israel; American indie pop artist Claire Cottrill known for her bedroom-pop origins and acclaimed albums including 'Sling' (Sources: Haaretz, NPR, Billboard, Rolling Stone, NME, The National)
- [Cynthia Nixon](https://artsiren.co/artist/cynthia-nixon/): Stance Unclear. American actress known for 'Sex and the City' and former New York gubernatorial candidate who signed the 2023 Artists' Pledge for Palestine; also led a group of actors publicly backing ICJ genocide charges against Israel. Also signed the Film Workers for Palestine pledge (September 2025), refusing to work with Israeli film institutions it calls complicit in genocide. (Sources: NBC News, Times of Israel)
- [Dame Maureen Lipman](https://artsiren.co/artist/dame-maureen-lipman/): Welcomes All. British actress and one of the UK's most outspoken public defenders of Israel and the Jewish community. Following October 7, 2023, she urged Jews to "stand proud and speak out" against rising antisemitism and signed the Creative Community for Peace open letter supporting Israel's inclusion in Eurovision 2026. (Sources: The Jewish Chronicle, Ynet)
- [Damon Albarn](https://artsiren.co/artist/damon-albarn/): Cultural Boycott. Used the word 'genocide' in a Channel 4 News interview (August 2025), stating 'I'm with the Palestinians'; performed with Gorillaz at the Together for Palestine benefit concert at Wembley Arena (September 2025); dedicated a Glastonbury appearance to 'all the children in Palestine' (June 2024) (Sources: NME, Stereogum)
- [Danny Glover](https://artsiren.co/artist/danny-glover/): Stance Unclear. American actor known for the 'Lethal Weapon' franchise who signed the 2023 Artists' Pledge for Palestine; has been a long-standing civil rights and anti-imperialist activist, signing multiple pro-Palestinian boycott declarations over the years. Has publicly called for a cultural boycott of Israel, including urging filmmakers to withdraw from a Tel Aviv film festival. (Sources: Times of Israel, Haaretz)
- [Dave Matthews Band](https://artsiren.co/artist/dave-matthews-band/): Cultural Boycott. Frontman Dave Matthews shouted 'Free Palestine' from concert stage (June-July 2024); physically protested at the US Capitol during Netanyahu's address to Congress (July 24, 2024); told Al Jazeera 'I'm ashamed that my tax dollars are going to the brutalizing of an entire people. It's shameful'; called Congress's support for Netanyahu 'disgusting' (Sources: NME, Variety, Newsweek, Billboard)
- [David Draiman](https://artsiren.co/artist/david-draiman/): Welcomes All. Lead vocalist of Disturbed and one of rock's most outspoken defenders of Israel and Jewish identity. Raised in an Orthodox Jewish home, he has slammed Roger Waters and other boycotters as 'Nazi comrades', publicly defended Israel during the Hamas war, told artists to ignore BDS pressure, raised $29K for Matisyahu's security after pro-Palestinian protests, responded to being booed at a Black Sabbath show by calling the hecklers 'Jew-hating morons', and said he would 'gladly serve jail time' if he ever met Roger Waters. His support caused Disturbed to announce a band hiatus in 2025 amid controversy, but Draiman stated he doesn't 'give a shit' about alienating people with his pro-Israel stance. (Sources: NME, Times of Israel, Consequence, Pittsburgh Jewish Chronicle)
- [David Mamet](https://artsiren.co/artist/david-mamet/): Welcomes All. Pulitzer Prize-winning American playwright who has written books defending Zionism and Israel, including "The Wicked Son" (2006). He signed the Creative Community for Peace statement and is a prominent defender of Israel in literary circles. (Sources: Haaretz, TheWrap)
- [Debra Messing](https://artsiren.co/artist/debra-messing/): Welcomes All. Among the most outspoken pro-Israel voices in Hollywood: signed multiple pro-Israel letters, traveled to Israel with the IDF to document the October 7 aftermath, publicly rejected the Israeli film industry boycott, and stated she has 'never felt as proud of being a Jew.' (Sources: Hollywood Reporter, CNN, Ynet)
- [Denzel Curry](https://artsiren.co/artist/denzel-curry/): Cultural Boycott. - [Devendra Banhart](https://artsiren.co/artist/devendra-banhart/): Cultural Boycott. - [Dua Lipa](https://artsiren.co/artist/dua-lipa/): Cultural Boycott. - [Elfriede Jelinek](https://artsiren.co/artist/elfriede-jelinek/): Welcomes All. Nobel Prize-winning Austrian author who signed a Creative Community for Peace letter rejecting the cultural boycott of Israel alongside over 1,000 other artists and entertainment figures, despite her own leftist political background. She has separately criticised Israeli 'land grabbing' in Gaza and the West Bank. (Sources: Jerusalem Post, Times of Israel)

- [Elton John](https://artsiren.co/artist/elton-john/): Welcomes All. Performed in Israel and explicitly rejected the cultural boycott when he played Tel Aviv in 2010, after other artists had cancelled, saying musicians "don't cherry-pick our conscience." (Sources: Haaretz, Billboard)
- [Elvis Costello](https://artsiren.co/artist/elvis-costello/): Cultural Boycott. Cancelled his June 2010 Tel Aviv and Caesarea concerts explicitly citing Israel's military actions against Palestinians; published a statement saying he could not 'in good conscience' appear in Israel, becoming one of the first major artists to cancel for political reasons (Sources: NME, Haaretz)

- [Eric Clapton](https://artsiren.co/artist/eric-clapton/): Cultural Boycott. Publicly declared support 'for the freedom of the people of Palestine' and 'against the genocide' alongside Roger Waters (June 2024); released Gaza fundraising music video 'Voice of a Child'; performs with Palestinian flag guitar; stated 'Israel is running the world' in May 2024. - [Finneas](https://artsiren.co/artist/finneas/): Cultural Boycott. Withdrew from his November 2026 South American tour dates opening for Ed Sheeran after Macklemore was removed from the tour over his 'Free Palestine' remarks, writing that 'artists must not be silenced when they speak up for the oppressed' and 'I stand with Palestine and its people' (September 2026). - [Fontaines D.C.](https://artsiren.co/artist/fontaines-dc/): Cultural Boycott. - [Four Tet](https://artsiren.co/artist/four-tet/): Cultural Boycott. British electronic music producer and DJ (real name Kieran Hebden) who joined the #DJsForPalestine cultural boycott of Israel in 2018, signing a letter alongside Four Tet, Caribou and The Black Madonna calling for an end to Israeli human rights violations (Sources: NME, Haaretz)
- [Gael Garcia Bernal](https://artsiren.co/artist/gael-garcia-bernal/): Cultural Boycott. Among the initial signatories of Film Workers for Palestine pledge (September 8, 2025) to boycott Israeli film institutions implicated in genocide and apartheid; previously signed open letters calling for an end to Israeli military operations (Sources: JTA, TheWrap, Jerusalem Post)
- [Gal Gadot](https://artsiren.co/artist/gal-gadot/): Welcomes All. Signed the October 2023 Creative Community for Peace open letter condemning Hamas's terrorist attacks, and posted publicly: 'My heart is aching for the lives lost and families shattered. I'm praying for everyone affected by Hamas' terrorism'; Israeli-born actress known for Wonder Woman. (Sources: Hollywood Reporter, Variety, NME)
- [Gene Simmons](https://artsiren.co/artist/gene-simmons/): Welcomes All. KISS co-founder and outspoken defender of Israel. Israeli-born (Chaim Witz), he has blasted anti-Israel boycotts of arts festivals, signed letters opposing Israel's exclusion from Eurovision, and proposed a global 'Never Again' concert at Holocaust memorial sites. (Sources: NME, Times of Israel)
- [Gil Scott-Heron](https://artsiren.co/artist/gil-scott-heron/): Cultural Boycott. Late African-American poet and musician often called the godfather of rap; signed statements of cultural solidarity with Palestinians and endorsed the artistic boycott of Israel during his lifetime; his political legacy has influenced generations of BDS-supporting artists (Sources: Newsweek, Times of Israel)
- [Ginnifer Goodwin](https://artsiren.co/artist/ginnifer-goodwin/): Welcomes All. Signed the Creative Community for Peace open letter supporting Israel's inclusion in Eurovision 2026. She has also publicly explained that the slogan "Globalize the Intifada" is a call for violence against Jews. (Sources: Ynet, Jerusalem Post)
- [Godspeed You! Black Emperor](https://artsiren.co/artist/godspeed-you-black-emperor/): Cultural Boycott. Montréal post-rock collective who declined the Polaris Music Prize in 2013, issuing a statement explicitly critical of Israeli military actions and calling for boycott; have been consistently anti-Zionist in their public statements (Sources: Exclaim!, Billboard Canada)
- [Green Day](https://artsiren.co/artist/green-day/): Cultural Boycott. Billie Joe Armstrong made consistent public pro-Palestine statements: changed lyrics of 'Jesus of Suburbia' to reference Palestinian suffering at Corona Capital (November 2024) and Coachella (April 2025); carried a Palestinian flag onstage in Malaysia (February 2025) (Sources: Variety, NME)
- [Gregg Sulkin](https://artsiren.co/artist/gregg-sulkin/): Welcomes All. British-Jewish actor who has stated "I am very proud to be Jewish and love Israel." He had his bar mitzvah in Jerusalem, has spoken publicly about fighting antisemitism, and signed the Creative Community for Peace open letter supporting Israel's inclusion in Eurovision 2026. (Sources: The Jewish Chronicle, Ynet)
- [Guns N' Roses](https://artsiren.co/artist/guns-n-roses/): Welcomes All. Performed in Tel Aviv despite BDS calls, drawing a sold-out crowd of 60,000 fans. The band declined to participate in the cultural boycott of Israel. (Sources: Times of Israel, Ynet)
- [Guy Pearce](https://artsiren.co/artist/guy-pearce/): Cultural Boycott. Confidential and Iron Man 3. (Sources: Variety, NBC News)
- [Halsey](https://artsiren.co/artist/halsey/): Cultural Boycott. Broke public silence in November 2023 to reaffirm 'my stance regarding the liberation of the Palestinian people' and pledged donations to relief organizations; condemned Israel's offensive on Rafah (May 2024) (Sources: Newsweek, NME)
- [Hania Rani](https://artsiren.co/artist/hania-rani/): Cultural Boycott. Signed No Music for Genocide pledge, geo-blocked music from Israel and requested removal from Spotify Israel; Polish pianist and composer known for delicate, minimalist compositions; one of Europe's most acclaimed contemporary classical artists to join the boycott (Sources: Haaretz, NPR, Billboard, Rolling Stone, NME, The National)
- [Hannah Einbinder](https://artsiren.co/artist/hannah-einbinder/): Cultural Boycott. Said 'Free Palestine' in her Emmy acceptance speech at the 2025 Emmy Awards; signed the Film Workers for Palestine boycott pledge, refusing to work with Israeli film institutions; stated it is her 'obligation as a Jewish person to distinguish Jews from the State of Israel.' (Sources: Hollywood Reporter, NPR, Deadline)
- [Harold Pinter](https://artsiren.co/artist/harold-pinter/): Cultural Boycott. Nobel Prize-winning playwright who was a founding member of Jews for Justice for Palestinians and backed a boycott of Israeli produce; signed open letters accusing Israel over its military operations in Gaza and Lebanon. (Sources: The JC, Ynet)

She has also performed and attended events in Israel, declining pressure to boycott the country. (Sources: The Hollywood Reporter, Deadline)

Nobel Prize-winning German-Romanian author who signed a Creative Community for Peace letter rejecting the cultural boycott of Israel. (Sources: Times of Israel, The JC)

Called for a ceasefire in Gaza at Lollapalooza 2024 and joined Macklemore's 'Free Palestine' concert in Dublin in October 2026. (Sources: NME, RTÉ)

He donated the $10,000 prize to Israeli-Palestinian peace organisation Combatants for Peace. (Sources: Jewish Chronicle, Jewish Telegraphic Agency)
